720-1806-2034-4446.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
720-1806-2034-4446.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
720-1806-2034-4446.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adidng {C}{C}.
When Eternal Scourge dies, Kinzu of the Bleak Coven and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Kinzu of the Bleak Coven trigger, causing you to pay 2 life and exile Eternal Scourge from your graveyard to create a token copy of it that is 1/1.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Eternal Scourge token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Eternal Scourge token dies, Relic Vial triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.

2228-4279-5332.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
An opponent controls a creature.
2228-4279-5332.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature, targeting any creature an opponent controls.
When the sacrificed creature dies, Carmen triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on a creature an opponent controls, and causing you to draw a card.
Hapatra triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
2228-4279-5332.notes: You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control. The lock will end once you've drawn your library.

792-4279-6559--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
792-4279-6559--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Venerated Stormsinger, Totentanz and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Venerated Stormsinger trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Totentanz ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Venerated Stormsinger triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

728-3249-3755-6112--52.easyPrerequisites: Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-3755-6112--52.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature castable for one mana, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, Fumulus triggers, creating a creature token or a token that adds mana.
If you created a creature token, repeat steps 1 and 2 to sacrifice that token and add an additional mana.
If you created a token that adds mana, instead activate that token to add mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast the sacrificed creature from your graveyard this turn.
Cast that creature from your graveyard by paying one mana.
Repeat.

539-4687-5479.notablePrerequisites: Lost Jitte has at least three charge counters on it.
539-4687-5479.description:
Activate Ashaya by tapping Gilder Bairn, producing its effect.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on Lost Jitte.
Activate Lost Jitte two times by removing three charge counters from it, untapping two lands.
Activate those lands by tapping them, adding {1}{G/U}.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite counters on Lost Jitte, you may instead double the counters on any other permanents.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1123-6972-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Flayer of the Hatebound
When Flayer of the Hatebound dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Flayer of the Hatebound enters, it triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Flayer of the Hatebound
When Flayer of the Hatebound dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Flayer of the Hatebound enters, it triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve both Hammerhead abilities from step 1 and 4.
Repeat.
1123-6972-8095.notes: If Flayer of the Hatebound starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

1349-6863-8095--133.easyPrerequisites:
You have enough mana to cast the Dinosaur in your hand.
There is a coin counter on Blue.
1349-6863-8095--133.description:
Cast the Dinosaur in your hand by paying its mana cost. It will enter with a coin counter due to Blue.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the Dinosaur.
When the Dinosaur dies, Athreos's second ability triggers, returning the Dinosaur from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will enter with a coin counter due to Blue.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat from step 2.

1086-1981-2415-2438.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1086-1981-2415-2438.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Anointer Priest triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

1895-4399-4518-5789.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Pearl Medallion.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Lifecreed Duo triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Lifecreed Duo trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Lifecreed Duo trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1895-4399-4518-5789.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

978-1477-6972.description:
Activate Extruder by sacrificing it.
When Extruder dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Extruder ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

1183-2034-6972.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Pentavus.
When Pentavus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.
1183-2034-6972.notes: Each loop, you can use mana from the previous loop and remove a +1/+1 counter from Pentavus to make creature tokens.

206-240-5470-5686.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability, creating a Blood token
Repeat from step 2.

2933-4460-4499-5798.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

uses.battlefieldCardState: is paired with Patron of the Arts

1409-1652-1770.description:
Activate Patron of the Arts by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Patron of the Arts enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Patron of the Arts.
Resolve both Patron of the Arts triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a film counter on it

57-4846-5223-6924.notablePrerequisites: You control any number of permanents that enter untapped and that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{R}.
57-4846-5223-6924.description:
Activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least {4}{R}.
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Holding priority, activate Peter Parker's Camera by paying {2}, tapping and removing a film counter from it, copying Feldon's ability targeting Worldgorger Dragon.
Resolve the copy of Feldon's ability, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
Resolve the Feldon ability from step 2, creating a token copy of Worldgorger Dragon.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token enters, its first ability triggers, exiling all other permanents you control.
When the Worldgorger Dragon token created in step 4 leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning all cards exiled with it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3446-3532-5078-6608.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Jace's Projection triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with a film counter on it

3649-5277-6924.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls three nontoken creatures that they own and that are not commanders.
3649-5277-6924.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Etrata, triggering its ability.
Holding priority, activate Peter Parker's Camera by paying {2}, removing a film counter from it and tapping it, targeting Etrata's trigger.
Holding priority, activate Abstruse Archaic by paying {1} and tapping it, copying Peter Parker's Camera's trigger, targeting Etrata's trigger.
Resolve both Peter Parker's Camera's triggers, copying Etrata's trigger twice.
Resolve all Etrata triggers, exiling three creatures an opponent controls and putting hit counters on them, and then causing that opponent to lose the game.

339-677-2511-4885.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

826-2846-3899-6243.notablePrerequisites:
Amoeboid Changeling does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least X Vampires.
826-2846-3899-6243.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, removing all creature types from Dominating Vampire.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Dominating Vampire.
When Dominating Vampire dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Dominating Vampire from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel with flying and a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Dominating Vampire enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Amoeboid Changeling.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat.

5663-6797--5.notablePrerequisites: The persist creature does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
5663-6797--5.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Repeat.

2646-3327-4613-5073.notablePrerequisites: You have sacrificed at least three artifacts and/or creatures this turn, plus an additional artifact or creature for each time you've cast Dargo from the command zone this game.
2646-3327-4613-5073.description:
Cast Dargo from the command zone by paying {R}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Bloodspore Thrinax.
Activate Dargo using Tinder Wall's ability by sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Choose to return Dargo from your graveyard to the command zone.
Repeat.

2034-2178-5173-6095.easyPrerequisites:
Zul Ashur, Lich Lord does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Zul Ashur.
2034-2178-5173-6095.description:
Activate Zul Ashur by tapping it, targeting Shambling Ghast.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Shambling Ghast, adding {C}{C}.
When Shambing Ghast dies, it and Zul Ashur trigger.
Resolve the Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Zul Ashur trigger, untapping it.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

826-2059-3899-6243.notablePrerequisites: Amoeboid Changeling does not have summoning sickness.
826-2059-3899-6243.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling's second ability by tapping it, removing all creature types from Village Bell-Ringer.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Village Bell-Ringer.
When Village Bell-Ringer dies, Valkyrie's Call triggers, returning Village Bell-Ringer from your graveyard to the battlefield as an Angel with flying and a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Village Bell-Ringer enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Amoeboid Changeling.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability, putting a charge counter on it.
Repeat.

4499-4605-5420-5542.description:
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Plundering Pirate.
When Plundering Pirate enters the battlefield, it triggers once, and Preston triggers twice.
Resolve the Plundering Pirate trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the first Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Plundering Pirate that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Plundering Pirate token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat from step 4 for the remaining Preston trigger.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

1856-4550-5147.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
1856-4550-5147.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
When the Zombie enters the battlefield, Doom Weaver's soulbond ability triggers, pairing it and the Zombie.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Zombie.
When the Zombie dies, it triggers, causing you to draw cards equal to its power.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

3079-3613-4659-4999.notablePrerequisites: You have discarded at least two cards this turn.
3079-3613-4659-4999.description:
Cast Hollow One either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying at most {1}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Hollow One, adding {C}{C}.
If you cast Hollow One from your graveyard, Hollow One is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Dress Down removing Hollow One's cycling ability.
Repeat.

919-1272-2051-2546.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two additional land cards in hand.
919-1272-2051-2546.description:
Activate Lonely Sandbar's cycling ability by paying {U} and discarding it.
 Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Lonely Sandbar ability, causing you to mill three cards and return Life from the Loam from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Seismic Assault by discarding a land card.
Surly Badgersaur's second ability triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve the Seismic Assault ability, dealing 2 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 4 one additional time.
Activate the three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Cast Life from the Loam by paying {1}{G}, returning Lonely Sandbar and two other lands from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2440-3705-4050-4720.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Goblins.
2440-3705-4050-4720.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee, adding {R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Squee enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Goblin you control.
Activate Stonework Packbeast by paying {2}, adding {R}.
Repeat.
If you control four or more Goblins, this combo nets infinite mana.

586-1622-2232.description:
Cast Priest of Gix by paying {2}{B}.
Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, triggering itself, Cloudstone Curio and Minion Reflector.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Minion Reflector trigger, causing you to pay {2} to create a token copy of Priest of Gix with haste.
The Priest of Gix token enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Cloudstone Curio.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the nontoken Priest of Gix from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1518-1987-3227.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.You control an artifact or land that enters the battlefield untapped and can produce {U}.
1518-1987-3227.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Scrivener and your untapped source, blinking them both.
When Scrivener enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to your hand.
Tap your untapped blue source for {U}.
Repeat.
